1991.notes: Resident rate is the combined CAGIT or COIT plus CEDIT rate for the calendar year; the components are not modelled separately. Deduction is the $1,000 per person exemption. The City of Fort Wayne's 2014 budget ('Taxes based on income', budget page 8) narrates the Allen County rate history: the county option income tax began July 1, 1989 at 0.2%, rose to 0.3% on July 1, 1990 and stayed frozen at 0.3% until July 1, 1992 (0.4%), then 0.5% from July 1, 1993 and 0.6% from July 1, 1994; CEDIT began at 0.2% on July 1, 1993. So 0.3% for the whole of 1991; the Department of Revenue's Form IT-40P booklet chart of 1992-1996 county rates (http://web.archive.org/web/20040716084947/http://www.in.gov:80/dor/taxforms/96pdfs/it-40p.pdf, page 13) prints .0035 for 1992, consistent with this. 1989, 1990 and 1992-1994 changed mid-year.

Deduction is the $1,000 per person exemption. 1992 rate from the 'Resident County Tax Rates' chart (columns 1992 to 1996) on page 13 of the Department of Revenue's Form IT-40P booklet for 1996 and earlier tax years (Wayback Machine copy of the Department's prior-year forms page, PDF page 13); the chart gives one calendar-year rate per county, prorated where a county's rate changed during the year.
